rv.q: You’ll forget about it in a couple of days but you’ll be entertained while you’re there.
This dark comedy is sure to delight you.
This comedy-thriller is indeed “Madkap” fun employing startling special effects on a retro inspired set design by Brian Wasserman with lighting by Pat Henderson.

cn.t: MadKap's revival of Levin's classic thriller delivers fine acting and sharp direction, with Michael Lomenick's tour de force performance anchoring this engaging web of deceit and humor before appreciative audiences.
